title: Ain't No Sunshine
hook: Why Ain't No Sunshine feels *so empty*
cover_text: The chord that *feels like an empty room*

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Minor v: *G, not G♯*. Nothing pulls you home.

chords.name: G
chords.text: *G major*: a flicker of light, then gone.

chords.name: Am
chords.text: Back to A minor. *The room is still empty*.
